title: Time workspace tests once and fix the single slowest test cause
summary: Retry of 20261031-043018-kjy2 (and 9h6z), narrowed per the user: one timed full test run to list the ten slowest test binaries, then one fix of the biggest cause inside the slowest binary, or no code change if coverage would be lost. The CHANGELOG entry carries the timings. Wider cause hunting across crates and build settings is left to follow-up requests.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria check the changed binary's before/after time, not the activity.
cargo test, clippy -D warnings and fmt --check must pass.
Fix only the biggest cause found by timing.
Same tests pass; no tests deleted or ignored.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs, crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs, crates/athena-core/src/checks.rs and crates/athena-agent/src/procs.rs by search; sleep calls and process spawns cluster in crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs and crates/athena-agent/src/procs.rs, the likely slow tests. Per-binary 'finished in N s' lines from cargo test are the direct measure; no validation allow-list or record file is added.

Prior jobs: kjy2's and 9h6z's candidates changed nothing (no candidate), so there is no work to keep or drop; their deliverables other than the changed test file and CHANGELOG.md (Cargo.toml files, status_durations.rs, run/tests.rs) are dropped as follow-ups unless the timings show they are the slowest binary.
Goal: the maintainer shrinks check time. Audience: the maintainer and verifier reading CHANGELOG.md. The producer runs the full suite at most twice (measure, confirm).
Scope kept to one deliverable (one test file's fix plus its CHANGELOG entry) so the job fits inside the verifier timeout; a no-fix outcome with only the CHANGELOG timings is acceptable.
The fix is judged by 'finished in' times of the changed test binary, at least 30% faster with the same tests passing.

acceptance_criteria.text: CHANGELOG.md has a new entry listing the ten slowest test binaries with 'finished in' times from one full run of the base, and the slowest tests inside the slowest binary.

Either the entry gives before and after times of the one changed test binary showing at least 30% faster plus before and after times of the whole run, or it explains why the biggest cause cannot be fixed without losing coverage and no code changes (git diff shows only CHANGELOG.md).
Run `cargo test --workspace`: all tests pass, and the test count is not lower than before. git diff shows no removed #[test] functions and no added #[ignore].
Run `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check`: both are clean.
git diff touches at most one test file plus CHANGELOG.md; athena.toml, Cargo.toml files and check_timeout_s are unchanged.

out_of_scope: Changing check_timeout_s or other values in athena.toml
Fixing more than the single biggest cause; further causes are follow-up requests
Changing Cargo.toml or crates/athena-core/Cargo.toml build settings (follow-up)
departures: Wall time is raised from the reference because two full runs at about 15 minutes each plus verification dominate, but kept below the 2400s verifier timeout at the median by limiting scope to one fix.
urgent_reason: Cuts wasted time: the two earlier attempts timed out at the 3000s producer deadline by rerunning the slow suite several times; this caps it at two runs.
